entries.keywords: inverter tripping high temperature igbt heatsink cooling fan thermal derating mppt
probable_causes: Clogged cabinet air filters or failed cooling blower fan
IGBT module thermal paste degradation or loose busbar connection
High ambient temperature inside ICR room with HVAC underperformance
next_actions: Check inverter fault code and IGBT heatsink temperature trend in SCADA
Inspect and clean cabinet intake filters and verify cooling fan rotation
Perform thermal imaging (IR scan) on DC/AC terminals before full-load restart

entries.keywords: burning smell continuous shutdown full block outage dc-link
probable_causes: DC-link capacitor overheating or internal arc fault
Failed exhaust blower causing cascading thermal trip
next_actions: Isolate inverter AC/DC breakers under LOTO before opening cabinet
Dispatch electrical technician for insulation resistance and IR inspection

entries.keywords: gearbox vibration abnormal noise grinding clunking high-speed shaft bearing cms accelerometer
probable_causes: High-speed or planetary bearing wear or spalling
Gear tooth pitting/misalignment or coupling imbalance
Low gearbox lube oil pressure or contaminated oil filter
next_actions: Review CMS vibration spectrum and bearing temperature in SCADA immediately
If severe knocking or metallic debris suspected, command controlled turbine pause
Collect gearbox oil sample for ferrography and inspect magnetic chip detector

entries.keywords: inspection checklist pending audit sign-off statutory preventive maintenance overdue certificate
probable_causes: Field inspection completed but checklist not uploaded to CMMS
Scheduled statutory or monsoon-readiness audit delayed by site team
next_actions: Verify physical inspection status with site shift lead
Upload signed checklist or schedule overdue test before compliance deadline

entries.keywords: scada data missing historian flatline nan meter frozen pyranometer telemetry
probable_causes: Local data logger / PLC polling freeze after network switch reboot
MODBUS/OPC-UA tag mapping error or revenue meter communication drop
next_actions: Check local inverter/WTG HMI to confirm actual power generation is unaffected
Restart SCADA polling service or verify RTU/historian link status

entries.keywords: blade pitch error mismatch feather wind gust actuator battery backup encoder
probable_causes: Pitch encoder feedback drift or loose limit switch
Low pitch emergency battery bank voltage or hydraulic pressure drop
Pitch motor overcurrent during rapid gust feathering
next_actions: Verify all three blade pitch angles and battery voltages in turbine controller
If unable to feather in high wind, keep turbine paused in safe state until inspection

entries.keywords: curtailment instruction sldc setpoint ppc dashboard active power limit reactive
probable_causes: PPC (Power Plant Controller) setpoint handshaking delay with SLDC RTU
SCADA dashboard tag scaling mismatch vs actual feeder export meter
next_actions: Compare actual pooling-substation feeder MW against SLDC dispatch setpoint
Verify PPC mode (auto vs manual) and sync telemetry with control center

entries.keywords: transformer buchholz relay winding temperature oil leak oltc differential bushing
probable_causes: Internal winding/core fault generating gas in Buchholz relay
Gasket/radiator flange degradation causing insulating oil leak
Cooling fan/pump failure or OLTC tap-changer mechanical jam
next_actions: Check Buchholz gas accumulation, oil level gauge, and OTI/WTI temperatures
Draw oil sample for Dissolved Gas Analysis (DGA) and contain any active oil leak
If Buchholz trip or smoke present, isolate transformer immediately

entries.keywords: tracker row stuck tilt stow slew drive inclinometer ncu battery
probable_causes: Tracker NCU controller battery depletion or wireless mesh drop
Slew-drive motor stall or mechanical torque-tube obstruction
next_actions: Check NCU battery voltage and motor current fault in tracker portal
If wind stow failed ahead of storm alert, manually stow affected rows

entries.keywords: rtu offline ping timeout modbus fiber ring break gateway unreachable comm fail
probable_causes: Fiber optic cable cut or dirty SFP transceiver on plant ring
RTU/gateway power supply trip or switch port lockup
next_actions: Ping RTU and intermediate managed switches to isolate the break segment
Confirm protection relays remain locally armed while remote link is restored

entries.keywords: smoke fire arc flash sparks burning smell injury near-miss oil spill cordon evacuate loto
probable_causes: Electrical insulation breakdown, loose termination, or arc flash event
Hazardous spill or personnel slip/fall during field work
next_actions: Enforce immediate area cordon, LOTO isolation, and personnel safety check
Notify Site EHS Officer and Plant Head; do not re-energize until clearance
